value.deck: GitHub Copilot, an AI assistant, just got a major upgrade, allowing it to connect with many more tools and do even more helpful things for you.
shortVersion: Imagine GitHub Copilot as your helpful AI assistant that writes code or helps with tasks. Now, it can become even more useful because new 'plugins' let it connect with many other tools and services. Think of these plugins like apps on your phone that add new features.

This means that people who make software can now create special add-ons for Copilot. These add-ons help Copilot understand more, use information from different places, and even follow custom steps to get work done. It's like giving your AI assistant new skills and knowledge.

This change opens the door for many new ways to use Copilot. Businesses can connect Copilot to their own specific tools, and other software can also work with it. This will make AI-powered work much smoother and more powerful.
value.plainLanguage: GitHub Copilot, an AI helper, can now connect with many other tools and services through new add-ons, making it much more capable and useful.

keyTerms.meaning: An AI assistant that helps people, especially those who write computer programs, by suggesting code or helping with tasks.
Small add-on programs that give a main program, like Copilot, new abilities or allow it to connect with other tools.
An AI program that can understand tasks, plan steps, and use tools to achieve a goal, acting like a smart assistant.
A network of different tools, services, and users that work together and grow around a main product, like Copilot.

value.whyItMatters: This matters because your AI tools, like Copilot, will become much smarter and more integrated into your daily work. Instead of switching between many apps, Copilot can now bring information and actions from different tools directly to you, making your tasks easier and faster.
watchNext: Look for Copilot to gain many new abilities as more companies and developers create these special add-ons.
Expect your AI tools to become more connected, pulling information and actions from various services into one place.
See how businesses start using Copilot with their own unique software to automate more of their specific tasks.
